_note: Seam: the statutory rules the deadline calendar computes from. Every rule is printed on the page beside the date it produced. Dates are never stored here — only rules.
verified: General rules as understood on 7 September 2026. The MTD for Income Tax quarterly dates and the PAYE electronic payment date were NOT confirmed against gov.uk for this example and carry a visible caveat.

rules.rule: nine months after the year end, for a private company
nine months and one day after the end of the accounting period
twelve months after the end of the accounting period
31 January after the tax year ends on 5 April
31 October after the tax year ends on 5 April
payments on account: 31 January and 31 July
6 July after the tax year ends on 5 April
one month and seven days after the end of the VAT quarter
the 22nd of the following tax month when paid electronically
quarterly updates on 7 August, 7 November, 7 February and 7 May
